target.title: fix(workboard): avoid duplicate proof entries on completion
target.body:
Closes #110201

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where autonomous Workboard completion could retain two copies of the same proof: an unresolved `unknown` record followed seconds later by a new `passed` record. It also clarifies that Workboard proof statuses are worker-reported outcomes rather than independent verification.

## Why This Change Was Made

`workboard_proof` now returns the new record's `proofId`. When `workboard_complete` reports the terminal result for that same check, it can pass `proofId` to resolve exactly that pending record while preserving its id, timestamp, and evidence.

The correlation is explicit rather than inferred from matching command or note text. Completion without `proofId` remains append-only, a same-status terminal proof is reused idempotently, and an unknown result, conflicting terminal status, or conflicting evidence fails closed. That keeps identical retries from silently rewriting an earlier attempt. Historical duplicate pairs are not rewritten or migrated.

The public Workboard and CLI docs now define `passed` as worker self-attestation. An independent verifier hook is intentionally not introduced here because that would require a separate persisted/public contract decision.

AI-assisted: yes.

## User Impact

Workers that record proof before completion can carry the returned proof id into `workboard_complete`, avoiding the orphaned `unknown` copy without losing retry history. Operators and API consumers also have explicit guidance that `passed` does not itself prove independent verification.

## Evidence

- Before the fix, the focused regression reproduced two records with identical label, command, and note: `unknown` at 1000 ms and `passed` at 6000 ms.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/workboard/src/store.test.ts extensions/workboard/src/tools.test.ts extensions/workboard/src/dispatcher.test.ts` — 3 files, 134 tests passed.
- Targeted `oxfmt --check` across the 10 touched files — passed.
- Fresh autoreview after replacing content matching with explicit proof-id correlation — no accepted/actionable findings; overall `patch is correct` (0.91). A second fresh review after making same-status terminal correlation idempotent was also clean (0.93).
- Blacksmith Testbox lease `tbx_01kxwvb34hfkv7rm51p550vsay` built exact head `975f2149c7f9a9855317a72123d86499073ef5e5` with `pnpm build` — passed: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29681665884.
- Hosted exact-head CI is required and checked by the repository prepare gate.
- Exact-head black-box run used the built Gateway RPC surface and `openclaw workboard show --json`. Redacted terminal result:

```json
{
  "head": "975f2149c7f9",
  "pendingCorrelation": {
    "proofCount": 1,
    "proofId": "a6c14958-0c6f-40ac-be67-e0a59bd8d243",
    "createdAt": 1784453593212,
    "status": "passed",
    "identityPreserved": true
  },
  "withoutProofId": {
    "proofCount": 2,
    "statuses": ["unknown", "passed"]
  },
  "terminalCorrelation": {
    "proofCount": 1,
    "proofId": "b359090f-06aa-4840-b657-9659a6c35186",
    "createdAt": 1784453627290,
    "status": "passed",
    "identityPreserved": true
  }
}
```

No UI surface changed, so screenshots are not applicable.
